name: vinilogs-firestore-rules-tests
description: Firestore security rules unit tests (T-14) — run against the Firestore emulator, not a real project. See ../02-ARCHITECTURE.md §3/§4/ADR-4 and firestore.rules for the rules under test. firebase-tools is pinned to ^13.35.1 (not latest) because 14.x+ hard-fails with 'firebase-tools no longer supports Java version before 21' and only JDK 17 is available in this environment; 13.35.1's floor is Java 11, and its bundled Firestore emulator jar works fine — see the PR for T-14 for the full note.
